name: grenz-webmcp
description: Deny-by-default policy layer for WebMCP tools: registration takeover, human approval, audit timeline.

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts src/react.tsx src/install.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --target=es2022 --external:react --outdir=dist && esbuild src/install.ts --bundle --format=iife --platform=browser --target=es2022 --minify --outfile=dist/grenz-install.js && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && bun scripts/fix-dts.ts
scripts.spike: bun build ./spike/spike.ts --outfile=./spike/spike.js --format=iife --target=browser && bun run build && cp dist/grenz-install.js spike/grenz-install.js && echo 'Now serve ./spike and open takeover-spike.html'
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run build && cd ../.. && bun test
